options.why: Amounts outside and coins inside count choices of the last coin, so 1+2 and 2+1 become separate sequences.
Each coin is introduced once; ascending totals can reuse that coin while earlier coin types remain represented.
Descending totals read the previous coin layer, allowing at most one copy of each denomination.
Sorting the totals does not supply the coin-by-coin recurrence or the ways[0] base.

items.explanation: Current-layer smaller sums allow reuse without ordered overcount.
